releases.notes:
# Swing v1.5.0
**Minecraft:** 26.2 · **Fabric Loader:** 0.19.5+ · **Fabric API:** 0.161.0+26.2 · **Java:** 25
## What changed since v1.0.0
### Added
- **Ignore Haste toggle** — keeps swing animation speed constant regardless of haste / mining fatigue. Off by default.
- **Apply Hand Scale toggle** — extends held item scale to the bare arm mesh when holding nothing. Off by default.
- **Item offsets (X / Y / Z)** — positional offset for the first-person held item model (`-1.00` to `1.00`)
- **Item tilt (Pitch / Roll)** — X and Z rotation for the held item (`-90` to `90°`)
- **Arm offsets (X / Y / Z)** — separate positional offset for the bare arm, active when Apply Hand Scale is ON
- **Arm tilt (Pitch / Roll)** — X and Z rotation for the bare arm, active when Apply Hand Scale is ON
- Settings panel is now scrollable to fit all controls
### Changed
- Full package and class rename (`com.example.itemtweaks` → `com.flapjacck.swing`) — existing `config/swing.json` settings carry over unchanged
- Merged into a single source set; removed Fabric template boilerplate from `build.gradle`
- Mixin method prefixes updated from `itemtweaks$` to `swing$`
- Assets moved from `assets/itemtweaks/` to `assets/swing/` to match the mod ID
### Fixed
- Slider track label now displays negative offset and tilt values correctly (was clamped to `0.10`)
- Edit box character limit increased to 6 to fit values like `-1.00` and `-45.00`
- Scroll widget duplication bug — widgets were re-added on every scroll tick instead of repositioned in place
## Install
Drop `fabric-swing-1.5.0.jar` into your `mods` folder along with Fabric API. Skip the `-sources` jar.

releases.notes:
# Swing 1.0.0 | Initial Release

A lightweight client-only Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that lets you customize your first-person item appearance and arm swing animation.

## Current Features
- **Item Scaling**: Adjust the size of your held item in first-person view (0.10–1.00 scale)
- **Swing Speed Control**: Customize your arm swing animation speed (0.10–1.00)
- **Live Settings Panel**: In-game `/swing` command opens an intuitive settings UI with sliders and number input
- **Instant Application**: Changes apply immediately without restart
- **Auto-Save**: Settings persist to `config/swing.json` and reload on next launch
- **Third-person Unaffected**: Scaling is disabled in third-person (F5) to keep vanilla compatibility
- **Server-Safe**: Client-only mod. Nothing changes on the server, purely visual

## Coming Soon
- Cleaner, more polished GUI redesign
- X and Y axis offsets for fine-tuning item position
- Additional customization options

## Notes
This is an initial v1 release and will see significant changes in upcoming versions. Perfect for players who want minimal, focused hand-model tweaks without the bloat of larger mods.
